title: party.item
description: An item from the hidden bag used on a Pokémon (FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.4): Cobblemon applies it with its own amounts; a refusal comes back as act.result{kind:"item"}.

slot.description: TM/HM: the move slot replaced (older senders; forget names the move).

id.description: Idempotent: Cobblemon applies an id once; gen1-bridge re-sends it after snapshots until a sync follows.

kind.description: What the item does: medicine is HP, status and Revive; pp Ether, Elixir, PP Up, PP Max; vitamin EVs; other anything new (Cobblemon warns, the hidden effect stands). Absent: decided from item and move, as before.

forget.description: TM/HM: the move the taught one replaced (by number: the hidden slot and Cobblemon's need not match).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
